description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order made to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Dried fish, Butter, Salt, etc. be valid for a period of 06 months commencing from 02.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette content imposes a Special Commodity Levy on various goods under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It establishes regulatory rates for specific commodities (dried fish, yogurt, butter, garlic, oranges, etc.) and represents the exercise of statutory powers to create subsidiary legislation. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does so only to establish the legal authority for the regulatory action rather than focusing on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about implementing a legal/regulatory framework for commodity taxation.
